# symstrategies/branch/core

`CAIMEOX/symbit/symstrategies/branch/core` is the public import path for this package.

Core branching strategy primitives shared by the higher-level branch strategy packages.

## When To Use This Package

- Import `CAIMEOX/symbit/symstrategies/branch/core` directly when your code depends on this package's subsystem-specific types or algorithms.
- Prefer this package over the root facade when you want the focused API surface listed below rather than a convenience wrapper.
